paper_metadata.title: Variational quantum classifiers through the lens of the Hessian

experiments.description: Warm-up variational quantum classifier for the 4-bit parity problem, used to study Hessian eigenvalues and loss landscape curvature during training.

algorithm.ansatz: feature map with Rx gates; variational layers with Ry and Rz rotations plus CNOT entanglers
algorithm.convergence_criteria: trained for 100 iterations; convergence assessed by loss minimization and Hessian eigenvalue behavior

hyperparameters.loss_function: square of trace distance / equivalent to Dt(|ψi0hψ|)^2

problem_formulation.encoding_details: 4-bit binary strings encoded into a 4-qubit quantum state via a feature map
problem_formulation.objective_function: minimize the cost function defined as the square of trace distance between the final state and the target/initial state representation

problem_instance.description: Binary classification of 4-bit parity (odd/even number of ones)

dataset_specification.description: Input vectors are 4-bit strings; labels are parity classes 0/1

problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Loss landscape visualized for selected parameters (θ3 and θ7); Hessian eigenvalues recorded during training iterations

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Binary parity inputs encoded into qubits; random parameter initialization
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Expectation value thresholding on one measured qubit to assign class labels

experiments.description: Variational quantum classifier for the Pima Indians Diabetes dataset, used to analyze Hessian eigenvalues and loss landscape curvature during supervised binary classification.

algorithm.variant: data-driven variational quantum classifier for diabetes classification
algorithm.ansatz: feature map with Hadamard, Ry, and CZ entanglers; variational layer with single-qubit rotations R(φ1, φ2, φ3)
algorithm.convergence_criteria: trained for 30 iterations; convergence assessed by loss minimization and Hessian eigenvalue behavior

hyperparameters.measurement_basis: Pauli operators in a specific direction / Z-measurement discussed in figures
hyperparameters.loss_function: distance between prediction and label, averaged over samples

algorithm.parameter_initialization: other parameters set to optimal values for landscape visualization; training parameters updated iteratively (initialization not explicitly specified)

problem_formulation.encoding_details: 8 classical features encoded into 8 qubits; each segment of classical data encoded into the amplitude of a qubit using single-qubit rotations
problem_formulation.objective_function: minimize average prediction-label distance for binary classification of diabetes

problem_instance.description: Binary classification of diabetes using the Pima Indians Diabetes dataset

dataset_specification.description: 8 input features: age, glucose, insulin, pregnancies, BMI, skin thickness, diabetes pedigree function, blood pressure; binary label 0/1

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Input vectors normalized to lie in [-π, π]
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Loss landscape visualized for selected parameters (θ0 and θ24; also θ1 and θ25); Hessian eigenvalues recorded during training iterations

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Pima Indians Diabetes features encoded into qubits; inputs normalized to [-π, π]
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Prediction obtained from measured qubit expectation values; loss computed as average distance from labels

experiments.description: Adaptive Hessian learning rate training experiment on the 4-bit parity VQC, comparing adaptive learning-rate scheduling against fixed learning-rate gradient descent.

algorithm.variant: adaptive Hessian learning rate (A-HLR) for variational quantum circuit training
algorithm.ansatz: same 4-qubit parity VQC ansatz as the warm-up experiment
algorithm.optimizer: gradient descent with adaptive Hessian learning rate
algorithm.convergence_criteria: loss difference between consecutive iterations below a threshold; learning rate reduced discretely until lowest value; if stuck at lowest LR, restart with higher LR

hyperparameters.learning_rate_set: discrete decreasing set of learning rates
hyperparameters.threshold_for_lr_update: difference between updated and previous cost below threshold
hyperparameters.negative_eigenvalue_threshold: hyperparameter used to decide global vs local minima

optimizer_settings.tolerance: difference of loss values in two consecutive iterations below tolerance
optimizer_settings.learning_rate_schedule: start with largest LR, decrease to next smaller LR when loss change is below threshold; restart from higher LR if stuck in local minima

problem_formulation.objective_function: minimize the parity classification loss while using Hessian eigenvalues to detect local minima and saddle points

problem_instance.description: Training the 4-bit parity classifier with adaptive Hessian-based learning-rate control

dataset_specification.description: Same parity dataset as warm-up experiment

problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Compared training cost curves for A-HLR versus fixed learning-rate gradient descent over 25 and 100 iterations

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Random initialization and discrete learning-rate selection
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Hessian eigenvalue count used to infer whether the solution is likely a global minimum or stuck in a local minimum

speedup_claims.baseline_method: gradient descent with fixed learning rates
speedup_claims.conditions: on the 4-bit parity VQC, comparing adaptive Hessian learning rate against fixed learning-rate gradient descent over 25 and 100 iterations
speedup_claims.caveats: No numeric speedup factor or wall-clock time is reported; comparison is qualitative based on cost curves.
